thread:
support_julie: FYI — MaplePay reporting a wave of 5xx/timeouts on hosted API for the last 20m. p95 jumping to ~12s, lots of 504s. customer provided sample request_id: rq_8a3f7c. Incoming volume looks normal for them.
eng_oncall_tom: Can you paste the error samples and a short repro? Any tenant isolation hints?
support_julie: Errors: 504 gateway timeout + 502 from gateway occasionally. Customer says they see: 
```
HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout
X-Request-ID: rq_8a3f7c
{"error":"backend request timed out"}
```
Repro steps they gave (simple):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" -d '{"model":"open-llm-13b","input":"summarize this...","max_tokens":512}'
```
They ran a steady 30 rps over 5m.
ops_bot: Incident runbook triggered: queue-depth-alert -> page oncall.
sre_sara: I pulled metrics: gateway.request_queue_depth (hosted) spike to 98 / 100 for the tenant's shard at 12:13 UTC. tail_latency p95 for requests to rtv-runtime jumped from 250ms -> 11.8s. Continuous-batcher backlog depth increased at the same time.
sre_sara: stack traces from runtime show many requests sitting in batcher queue waiting on earlier long-running tokens; eviction not keeping up. Logs: 
```
[12:12:41] batcher: enqueue req=rq_8a3f7c depth=98 max_depth=100
[12:12:42] batcher: dequeuing batch_size=1 (single long tail)
[12:12:42] runtime: starting generation (seq_len=1 ctx=4096)
[12:12:52] runtime: kv_cache_miss -> cold build, time=8.9s
[12:12:52] gateway: request timeout exceeded (10s)
```
ben_runtime: Looks like continuous batching window combined with a few long seq cold K/V cache rebuilds causing backlog. If batch window is too large and max_queue_depth near-capacity, a single cold long request stalls many.
support_julie: Customer insists they didn't change request shape. They use streaming? No. Regular non-stream.
eng_oncall_tom: Immediate mitigation options: 1) add per-tenant ingress throttling (soft cap) 2) lower continuous_batch_window_ms for the tenant shard 3) bump max_queue_depth or allow burst capacity to dedicated pool (if available) 4) route slow-model requests to a variant with smaller kv_cache warmup.
customer_success_maya: Maya -> told customer we're throttling to 15 rps for 10m while we investigate, asked for any recent prompt changes. They accepted.
sre_sara: I deployed a temporary policy: tenant-ratecap MaplePay -> 15rps. Queue depth dropped to ~30 and p95 fell to ~600ms. But we still saw occasional 5xx for in-flight long sequences.
ben_runtime: Short term patch: reduce continuous_batch_window_ms from 40ms -> 15ms for affected hosts; add a quick cold-kv timeout path to avoid blocking batchers longer than 1s. I'll push a canary.
eng_oncall_tom: Can you share the canary command and trace id once it's up? Also attach flame graphs for that time slice.
ben_runtime: Canary deployed to two hosts in us-west-2. Example trace: trace:tr_0b9f1c (linked) — initial results: average dequeue latency down 35%, p95 down to ~700ms. No additional 504s in canary for 10m.
sre_sara: Note: tenant was on a thinpool of shared GPUs and hit a cold-kv pattern after a small warmdown during ~11:55-12:05 UTC when a background job (customer's batch job) finished. Pattern: short idle window -> subsequent large prompt causes long kv build. We should consider separating long-seq jobs into a different QoS bucket.
support_julie: What's the long-term fix? Customer asking for SLA reassurance.
ben_runtime: Long-term: 1) stronger routing by request shape (seq_len hint / reported token count) 2) separate long-seq traffic into dedicated buckets or pre-warm KV cache on policy 3) dynamic batch window auto-shrink under high depth 4) improve kv-cache incrementalization to avoid 8-9s rebuilds.
eng_oncall_tom: Action items: @ben_runtime open PR with auto-shrink batch window + short-circuit cold-kv (ETA: 2 days). @sre_sara write runbook addition for tenant thinpool detection and temporary rate cap (ETA: today). @support_julie follow up with MaplePay and close escalation if stable (ETA: 30m).
support_julie: Customer updated: latencies improved after throttle + canary. They asked for a postmortem and to be notified when long-term mitigations are scheduled.
customer_success_maya: I'll own the customer comms and set expectation for a postmortem.
ops_bot: Pager closed by eng_oncall_tom (ack).
eng_oncall_tom: Marking incident as mitigated for now; will keep monitoring for 1 hour. If we see queue_depth > 80 again, trigger full incident.
sre_sara: Saved traces and logs to /sre/traces/1723456789/ for postmortem.
ben_runtime: Note for postmortem - include playback reproducer script that ramps 30rps with intermittent cold long seqs (I'll add to the ticket).
support_julie: Thanks team. Closing thread after stabilization. :thumbsup:
